Boiler repair in Leeds

A boiler that locks out in January is the call we get most. Our engineers carry the parts that fail most often on Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal, Baxi and Viessmann boilers, so most repairs are finished on the first visit, and every repair comes with a fixed quote agreed before we touch anything.

How much does a boiler repair cost?

The call-out is £95 including VAT for the first hour, day or night. Parts are charged at trade cost plus 15% and you see the list before we fit anything. If a repair would cost more than 40% of a replacement we say so and quote both options in writing.

Which fault codes can be reset at home?

Low-pressure faults such as EA on a Worcester or F22 on a Vaillant usually clear once the system is topped up to 1.5 bar with the filling loop. If the pressure drops again within a week there is a leak somewhere, and that needs an engineer.
